title: State-balance attenuation in binary phylogenetic-memory measurement

supersedes_unexecuted_estimator_design.reason: The earlier alternative changed both rank geometry and balance sensitivity. After the generator test, the identified next mechanism is narrower: remove only the exact binary state-balance attenuation term while retaining patristic-distance ranks and the same Mk2 states.

source_population: The identical 276 nominal-categorical systems from the artifact-backed Mk2 v0.4.1 aggregate.

generator_held_fixed.randomness: Reproduce the exact v0.4.1 Mk2 pilot states using the same deterministic root and edge uniforms and the same per-system FNV seed keys.

factorization.rho_identity: For X = patristic-distance rank and Y = binary pairwise mismatch, Spearman rho equals Delta_rank * sqrt(p*(1-p)), where p is the fraction of unordered tip pairs that mismatch and Delta_rank = (mean rank among mismatch pairs - mean rank among match pairs) / population SD of all pair-distance ranks.
factorization.balance_normalized_statistic: Delta_rank = rho / sqrt(p*(1-p)) for every non-monomorphic replicate.
factorization.target_derivation: rho=0.15 under maximally balanced pairwise mismatch prevalence p=0.5 corresponds exactly to Delta_rank=0.15/sqrt(0.25)=0.30.
factorization.tolerance_derivation: The original absolute rho calibration tolerance 0.01 maps to 0.02 on Delta_rank at p=0.5.

validity_rule_unchanged: A replicate is valid only when both tip states occur; system-level pilot valid_fraction must be at least 0.90.
calibration_search: Use the same frozen eta grid. Accept the first admissible grid point within tolerance; otherwise use the first adjacent admissible pair that straddles Delta_rank=0.30 and geometric-mean bisection for at most 20 steps. No grid extension.
primary_estimands: Balance-normalized Delta_rank no-bracket rate across all 276 systems.
Paired rescue count and fraction among the 170 systems that were no-bracket under Mk2 plus binary Spearman rho.
Paired new-failure count among the 106 systems that calibrated under Mk2 plus binary Spearman rho.
secondary_estimands: Distribution of calibrated eta under Delta_rank.
Median pilot valid fraction at calibrated eta.
Numerical identity check between direct rank-separation calculation and rho/sqrt(p*(1-p)) on deterministic test states.
directional_prediction: If state-balance attenuation explains a substantial part of the remaining categorical accessibility bottleneck, Delta_rank will rescue many of the 170 Mk2 rho no-bracket systems. If it does not, the remaining limitation lies in how even Mk2-generated binary partitions align with realized phylogenetic distance ranks rather than in mismatch prevalence alone.
interpretation_guard: Delta_rank removes one algebraically identified attenuation term. It is a mechanism diagnostic, not a claim that balance-normalized rank separation is the universally preferred biological estimator.
